# LIGHTSPEED receiver 046D:C547 ("USB Receiver") with a PRO X Superlight
# paired on slot 1. The mouse is switched off when BatterySight starts and
# switched on 30 s later.
#
# Real capture: owner capture 2026-11-23, G HUB closed. The
# trace also held the headset dongle; only this group's frames are kept
# (collections FF00:0001 short and FF00:0002 long), verbatim, except the
# mouse's unit id in the 0x0003 fn 0 reply, replaced by the synthetic
# 1A2B3C4D. The trailing `# +<s>` is the frame's time in the capture, counted
# from app start.
#
# Format: `out <short|long> <hex>` is a frame BatterySight writes, `in` one it
# reads, `@t+<ms>` lets time pass and ticks the hub. Each `in` advances the
# clock by 1 ms; `@t+` lines restore the capture's gaps over 100 ms. The `out`
# lines after an input are the writes that input causes.

# Group arrival: read the receiver's notification flags; wireless
# notifications are already on.
out short 10 FF 81 00 00 00 00  # +0.006 s
in  short 10 FF 81 00 00 01 00  # +0.008 s
# Ask the receiver to report every paired slot (register 0x02 = 0x02).
out short 10 FF 80 02 02 00 00  # +0.009 s
# Slot 1 is reported before the acknowledgement: 0x41 with byte 4 = 0x62
# (bit 6 set: link not established, the mouse is off) -> nothing is asked.
in  short 10 01 41 11 62 93 40  # +0.011 s
in  short 10 FF 80 02 00 00 00  # +0.012 s
# The mouse is switched on: 0x41 with byte 4 = 0xA2 (link established) ->
# Connected grant on the receiver -> ping slot 1 only.
@t+30167
in  short 10 01 41 11 A2 93 40  # +30.177 s
out short 10 01 00 1B 00 00 5A  # +30.177 s
# Two events of the mouse's feature index 4 (software id 0): no write.
in  long  11 01 04 00 01 01 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  # +30.178 s
in  long  11 01 04 00 01 01 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  # +30.179 s
# Ping reply, protocol 4.2: HID++ 2.0. Root getFeature 0x0005 (name and type).
in  long  11 01 00 1B 04 02 5A 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  # +30.187 s
out short 10 01 00 0B 00 05 00  # +30.187 s
# A reply to another HID++ client (software id 0xF): ignored.
in  long  11 01 00 0F 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  # +30.188 s
# 0x0005 -> index 3; 0x0003 (device info) -> index 2; 0x1004 (unified battery) -> index 6.
in  long  11 01 00 0B 03 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  # +30.198 s
out short 10 01 00 0B 00 03 00  # +30.198 s
in  long  11 01 00 0B 02 00 03 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  # +30.207 s
out short 10 01 00 0B 10 04 00  # +30.207 s
in  long  11 01 00 0B 06 00 01 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  # +30.216 s
# 0x0005 fn 0: name length 14; fn 1: "PRO X Wireless"; fn 2: type 3 (mouse).
out short 10 01 03 0B 00 00 00  # +30.216 s
in  long  11 01 03 0B 0E 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  # +30.225 s
out short 10 01 03 1B 00 00 00  # +30.225 s
in  long  11 01 03 1B 50 52 4F 20 58 20 57 69 72 65 6C 65 73 73 00 00  # +30.234 s
out short 10 01 03 2B 00 00 00  # +30.234 s
in  long  11 01 03 2B 03 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  # +30.243 s
# 0x0003 fn 0: entity count 3, then the unit id (synthetic 1A2B3C4D).
out short 10 01 02 0B 00 00 00  # +30.243 s
in  long  11 01 02 0B 03 1A 2B 3C 4D 00 0C 40 93 C0 94 00 00 01 00 00  # +30.252 s
# 0x1004 fn 1: 0x50 = 80 %, discharging -> registered.
out short 10 01 06 1B 00 00 00  # +30.252 s
in  long  11 01 06 1B 50 08 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  # +30.261 s
# The mouse's own battery broadcast (fn 0, software id 0): 80 %, no write.
@t+968
in  long  11 01 06 00 50 08 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00  # +31.158 s
